socialLinks.placement: Shared footer only, including on the homepage
socialLinks.treatment: Small labelled brand-icon links using the existing footer colours and visible focus states
socialLinks.source: Link only to verified business profiles; use the registered local SocialIcon for brand marks not available in Lucide

serviceEvidenceStat.role: A prominent, client-approved service-specific figure with its condition and meaning stated beside it
serviceEvidenceStat.surface: Open editorial rule on the charcoal results section, not a metric card
serviceEvidenceStat.colour: White figure with clay accent; no new colour token
serviceEvidenceStat.responsive: Two reading columns on desktop, one stacked column below 600px
serviceEvidenceStat.contentRule: Say what the number measures. A potential loss must not be presented as a measured gain from our work.

serviceAreaDetails.role: Optional named-town coverage within a service page, using only confirmed service areas and practical visit information
serviceAreaDetails.surface: Open text rows with shared rules in the existing local-service section; no location cards or duplicate town landing pages
serviceAreaDetails.heading: Descriptive service-and-town h3 headings under the existing local h2
serviceAreaDetails.responsive: Two reading columns above 900px and one column below 900px, following the service page layout
serviceAreaDetails.contentRule: Do not imply a separate office, guaranteed availability, or coverage beyond the confirmed service area

servicePreparation.role: Optional practical pre-visit guidance on a service page
servicePreparation.surface: Open two-column section with a short introduction and ruled action list, using existing colour and type tokens
servicePreparation.responsive: Two columns above 900px and one column below 900px
servicePreparation.contentRule: Give the customer useful information to provide before a visit; leave treatment-specific safety directions to the technician

serviceSeasonality.role: Optional researched local-season guidance beside a relevant landscape photograph
serviceSeasonality.surface: Open image-and-copy section using the shared wool, typography, spacing and image radius tokens
serviceSeasonality.responsive: Two columns above 900px, then copy followed by a shorter landscape image
serviceSeasonality.contentRule: Keep seasonal claims pest-specific and supported; describe the image without asserting an unverified location

serviceHeadingCopy.role: Optional service-specific headings for the existing fit and included-work sections
serviceHeadingCopy.source: Service content data, with shared template defaults for other services
serviceHeadingCopy.contentRule: Use natural service and place wording; keep the adjacent service-area copy clear about confirmed coverage
serviceHeadingCopy.layout: Use the existing section typography and responsive wrapping

serviceMediaFrames.hero: Minimum --service-media-hero-height, with text aligned to the shared container and the image clipped to its column; --service-media-compact-height below 900px; --service-media-mobile-height below 600px
serviceMediaFrames.technical: Fixed --service-media-technical-height frame centred beside content that may grow; --service-media-compact-height below 900px; --service-media-mobile-height below 600px
serviceMediaFrames.overflow: Images fill clipped frames and never determine section height or cover following content
serviceMediaFrames.orientation: Set per-image clockwise or counterclockwise rotation in service data only when the source photograph is sideways; keep it inside the existing clipped cover frame

components.name: ServicePage
components.description: Canonical shared layout for every service detail page. Each page supplies its own search title, service facts, reasons, included work, honest limits, process, media and related links. Media may provide distinct hero, work and technical images; every image keeps the shared clipped cover frames and responsive height tokens. The visual order, cover-image frames and homepage process pattern stay shared. The What to expect section identifies the numbered steps as our process. The results section shows genuine proof when available and otherwise uses service-specific copy without repeating earlier assurance text.
